title: Mack Superliner Custom Built Road Train FUPS Aluminium Bullbar #1
description: Mack Superliner FUPS Bullbar. 88mm dia pipe, 100mm dia pipe available. Chrome plate over tow hitch (can be painted black or to suit chassis). Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Indicator lights in channel. Full length box uprights for maximum protection. Reversible Road Train signs on alloy plate, cowcatcher and 5 small uprights. Bullbar can be custom built to your requirements.
